_README: Nutrition values for ingredients that Thai FCD has NO entry for.
Kept in a separate file from data/thaifcd_cache.json on purpose: that file is
'what INMU published', and mixing a second source into it would make its
provenance a lie. Anything here is explicitly not Thai FCD, and every recipe
that uses one of these says so in its nutrition_source.
See concern.md C12. Two of the 20 detectable YOLO classes are affected:
broccoli, which appears here, and onion, which does not need an entry because
it only ever appears in direct-lookup recipes where the whole dish is measured.
IMPORTANT -- the two databases do not define carbohydrate the same way.
USDA 'Carbohydrate, by difference' INCLUDES dietary fibre.
Summing them as-is would overstate carbs, which is enough to flip a keto tag.
So 'carb' below is stored on the Thai FCD basis: by-difference minus fibre.
Both raw numbers are kept alongside it so the subtraction is checkable.

EXT:usda-broccoli-raw.name_th: บรอกโคลี, ดิบ

carb_derivation.note: 6.64 - 2.6 = 4.04, converting the USDA figure onto Thai FCD's available-carbohydrate basis so the two sources can be summed in one recipe.

EXT:usda-broccoli-raw.citation: "Broccoli, raw." FoodData Central, 30 Oct. 2020, U.S.D.A., Agricultural Research Service, fdc.nal.usda.gov.
